title: Obuminsani mu Kibuga Eky’edda
intro: Ekibuga eky’edda ekyali kijjudde enfuufu, abantu baakyo nga basimbye amakanda mu kwegaana, n’okulabula okusembayo okwali tekufaayo. Leero muyingire mu kifo ky’abo Allah be yatuma okutuusa obubaka eri abantu abakakanyavu. Emboozi y’okugaana, eddoboozi ery’okukkiriza ery’omuntu omu, n’enkomerero essiddwako akabonero n’ekiragiro ekizikiriza. Ani ayogera ng’ayita mu bubonero buno?
clues: Allah yatusindika mu kibuga abantu baakyo mwe baali bavudde ku mazima
Twasooka babiri, olwo owookusatu ne yeegatta okunyweza obutume bwaffe
Abantu b’omu kibuga baatugaana nga bagamba nti tetuli kirala wabula abantu nga bo
Emmeeme emu okuva ku nkomerero y’ekibuga esinga ewala yadduka okugamba abantu batugoberere
Twabeegayirira, naye ne bakakanyaza emitima gyabwe ne batujeemera
Mu kukaaba okumu okw’amaanyi okuva mu ggulu, ekibuga kyaffe kyonna kyasirisibwa

trial.label: Okugezesebwa/Ekibaddewo
options: Baagaaniddwa era ne bayita abalimba abantu b’omu kibuga
Yayokebwa nga mulamu mu muliro omunene ogwayaka
Emira ekyennyanja ekinene mu nnyanja enzito
Okuwalirizibwa okukola emirimu nga bazimba empagi empanvu
trial.answer: Baagaaniddwa n’okuyitibwa abalimba abantu b’omu kibuga

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Ekibuga kino kyasaanyeewo olw’okukaaba okumu okusaanyawo (Sayha) .
Omutyobooli n’eggye lye babbira mu nnyanja eyawukana
Enkuba ey’amayinja eyatonnya okuva mu bbanga yasaanyaawo ekibuga
outcome.answer: Ekibuga kino kyasaanyeewo olw’okukaaba okumu okusaanyawo (Sayha) .

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
